newsitem.title: USA: White House derides Republican call for new budget.
newsitem.headline: White House derides Republican call for new budget.

text.p: White House budget chief Franklin Raines derided Republican lawmakers on Wednesday for calling on President Clinton to submit a second balanced budget proposal without first proposing one of their own.

"Anyone who doesn't have a first budget shouldn't be criticizing those who've got a budget," Raines, who heads the White House Office of Management and Budget, told the National Association of Business Economists.
Republican lawmakers have criticized Clinton's budget proposal, arguing that it does not really balance the budget by the year 2002 as promised, and have called on him to submit a new program.
